title: Bleaching-resistant, near-continuous single-molecule fluorescence and FRET based on fluorogenic and transient DNA binding
authors: Mirjam Kümmerlin; Abhishek Mazumder; Achillefs N. Kapanidis
one_liner_zh: 该文开发基于荧光DNA瞬时结合的抗光漂白单分子荧光/FRET方法，用于长时间观测DNA构象动态，虽涉及DNA结合但非TF-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅属实验技术，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Photobleaching of fluorescent probes limits the observation span of typical single-molecule fluorescence measurements and hinders observation of dynamics at long timescales. Here, we present a general strategy to circumvent photobleaching by replenishing fluorescent probes via transient binding of fluorogenic DNAs to complementary DNA strands attached to a target molecule. Our strategy allows observation of near-continuous single-molecule fluorescence for more than an hour, a timescale two orders of magnitude longer than the typical photobleaching time of single fluorophores under our conditions. Using two orthogonal sequences, we show that our method is adaptable to Förster Resonance Energy Transfer (FRET) and that can be used to study the conformational dynamics of dynamic structures, such as DNA Holliday junctions, for extended periods. By adjusting the temporal resolution and observation span, our approach should enable capturing the conformational dynamics of proteins and nucleic acids over a wide range of timescales.
abstract_zh: 荧光探针的光漂白限制了典型单分子荧光测量的观察时间跨度，并阻碍了对长时间尺度动力学的观察。在此，我们提出一种通用策略，通过荧光原性DNA与附着在靶分子上的互补DNA链的瞬时结合来补充荧光探针，从而规避光漂白。我们的策略允许在超过一小时内观察近乎连续的单分子荧光，这一时间尺度比我们条件下单个荧光团的典型光漂白时间长两个数量级。利用两种正交序列，我们展示了该方法适用于福斯特共振能量转移 (FRET)，并可用于长时间研究动态结构（如DNA霍利迪连接体）的构象动力学。通过调整时间分辨率和观察跨度，我们的方法应能捕获蛋白质和核酸在广泛时间尺度上的构象动力学。
